outcome.Summary: Rewrote Map in pool/pool.go (signature and doc comment unchanged) with a stop-once channel coordinated across three roles: workers select on stop/jobs (so they stop picking up inputs on error or cancellation and always exit), the dispatcher selects on stop/ctx.Done before handing out each input, and a collector stores results by input index into a preallocated out[i] (fixing ordering), tracks the lowest failing index for the *IndexError, observes which of cancellation vs call failure came first to decide between ctx.Err() and the error, and drains until results is closed (closed only after wg.Wait) — so Map waits for running calls, returns promptly on cancellation, and leaves no leaked goroutines. Added tests: TestOrderWithManyWorkers (out-of-order completion still yields input order), TestErrorIsLowestIndex (higher-index failures arrive first; asserts lowest index via errors.As, that new work stops, and goroutine/active settle), TestCancelled (returns context.Canceled, waits for running calls, no goroutine leak), TestAlreadyCancelled, plus the kept TestSquares. Verified with go vet and go test -race -count=1 ./... (plus a -count=5 run) — all pass.
